app.title: Tower Defense
app.tagline: Build mazes, hold the line, survive every wave.

howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.build: Pick one of your faction's four towers (or press 1-4) and click the grass to build it. Creeps follow the road, and nothing can be built on it.
howToPlay.path: Build along the bends of the road: a tower that covers two stretches shoots twice as often.
howToPlay.upgrade: Click a tower to upgrade or sell it. Kills and income earn gold.
howToPlay.waves: Press N to call the next wave early. Lose all your lives and the game is over.

lobby.comingSoon: The PvP lobby arrives in phase 3.

play.modeUnavailable: This game mode is not available yet.

hud.selectTowerHint: Select a tower to build, then click on the map

human-archer.name: Archer tower
human-archer.desc: Fires arrows at a single target.

human-stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
human-stormcaller.desc: Hurls lightning that tears through the line of creeps.

human-frostmage.name: Frost mage
human-frostmage.desc: Chills a target with ice and slows it down.

human-cannon.name: Cannon
human-cannon.desc: Fires heavy shells that burst on impact.

elf-ranger.name: Ranger bower
elf-ranger.desc: Looses swift arrows from a long distance.

elf-windsinger.name: Wind singer
elf-windsinger.desc: Sings a gale that pierces through several creeps.

elf-moonshrine.name: Moonfrost shrine
elf-moonshrine.desc: Bathes a target in moonfrost, slowing its steps.

elf-ballista.name: Ballista
elf-ballista.desc: Launches a huge bolt that explodes in an area.

orc-spearthrower.name: Spear thrower
orc-spearthrower.desc: Throws brutal spears at a single target.

orc-dusttotem.name: Dust totem
orc-dusttotem.desc: Whirls a cloud of dust that cuts through the line.

orc-icetroll.name: Ice troll
orc-icetroll.desc: Hurls frozen boulders that slow its prey.

orc-catapult.name: Catapult
orc-catapult.desc: Flings massive stones that crush groups of creeps.

undead-skeletonarcher.name: Skeleton archer
undead-skeletonarcher.desc: Shoots bone-tipped arrows at a single target.

undead-banshee.name: Banshee
undead-banshee.desc: Wails a spectral scream that pierces the line.

undead-lich.name: Lich
undead-lich.desc: Casts a freezing curse that slows its victim.

undead-plaguehurler.name: Plague hurler
undead-plaguehurler.desc: Hurls plague-ridden flesh that bursts in an area.

dwarf-rifletower.name: Rifle tower
dwarf-rifletower.desc: Fires slugs from a long rifle at a single target.

dwarf-teslacoil.name: Tesla coil
dwarf-teslacoil.desc: Discharges a lightning arc that chains through the line.

dwarf-cryosprayer.name: Cryo sprayer
dwarf-cryosprayer.desc: Sprays supercooled gas that slows its target.

dwarf-mortar.name: Mortar team
dwarf-mortar.desc: Lobs explosive shells that burst over a wide area.
